response.justification: The candidate is a strong individual-contributor software engineer with broad technical range (web, embedded, DLang, GIS platforms) but shows no evidence of executive-level leadership, team scaling, or P&L/board-level responsibility required for a CTO role. His AI-agent exposure is a recent, junior-scope contribution rather than production ownership of multi-agent systems in a regulated fintech environment, and there is no fintech credit/risk or compliance architecture experience.
strengths: Deep, diverse hands-on engineering background across multiple languages and domains (embedded, web, mobile, distributed systems)
Some current exposure to AI-agent infrastructure (MCP code generators, agentic frameworks) at re:cinq
Entrepreneurial drive shown via founding and maintaining an open-source platform (GISCollective) for nearly a decade
concerns: No leadership or people-management experience — never managed or scaled an engineering team, let alone 10→30+
No production-scale multi-agent AI system ownership; AI-agent work is recent and appears to be a contributor-level task, not an architected system
No fintech-specific experience with credit risk, working-capital management, or regulatory/compliance infrastructure

key_factors.factor: No production multi-agent AI system architecture experience
